Class ChromaticGalleryScreen

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.gui.Gui
net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiScreen
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.ChromaticGalleryScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiYesNoCallback
public final class ChromaticGalleryScreen extends net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiScreen
Interactive font gallery.

Every preview passes a real named formatting code to Minecraft's FontRenderer. Each card has its own animation clock; changing playback speed never changes the effect's geometry. Options construct a new effect through the public factory validator. Named-definition edits update the owning settings draft; Save in that screen writes the complete validated configuration. Externally registered effects remain read-only. Construct, open and use this screen only on the Minecraft client thread with an active graphics context.

Escape returns to the previous screen. Space pauses all previews, R restores the font presets, and M toggles the enlarged Matrix preview. Cards keep a compact height while the viewport chooses how many columns fit. The mouse wheel scrolls extra rows. Shift-clicking either speed control advances every card by one step, including filtered-out cards.
